free_tier_limits: Up to 100,000 requests per day without a key until January 1, 2027; thereafter an API key is required with a 100,000-request daily limit per key.
rate_limits: 100,000 requests/day; beyond that, requests may be rate-limited without notice. From January 1, 2027, an API key is required and the same daily limit applies per key.
resolution_notes: pricing.free_tier_limits: auditor correct. Official docs (https://www.datamuse.com/api/ Usage limits) state free use without an API key up to 100,000 requests/day until Jan 1, 2027; after that a key is required with 100,000 requests/day per key. rate_limits: auditor correct. Same page publishes the 100,000/day threshold and that requests beyond it may be rate-limited without notice, plus the 2027 auth change.
